notes: Two taḥwīl branches, each written in full: no shared tail. The second branch repeats its names, so it stands as its own group.
«واقتصوا الحديث بمعنى حديث يحيى بن أبي كثير عن أبي سلمة» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group.
«- يعنون ابن جعفر -» is an editor's gloss: left out. «قال كتبت ذلك من فيها كتابا» is Abu Salama's note on the writing, not a link.
